# Handoff Acknowledged

## Status Summary

| Metric | Champion | Last PASS |
|--------|----------|-----------|
| Tuning Mean | **1.904** | 1.762 |
| Tuning Min | **0.431** | 0.051 |
| Lockbox Mean | 1.793 | 1.793 |
| Lockbox Min | 1.134 | **1.347** |
| Worst MDD | **-9.3%** | -11.2% |

## Observations

1. **Champion holds** — candidate's weak tuning min (0.05) and deeper MDD (-11.2%) kept it from promotion despite slightly better lockbox min

2. **No INCONCLUSIVE queue** — clean state, no stalled experiments

3. **Runtime healthy** — 14 loops in ~83 min (~6 min/loop), well within 2-day budget

## Ready to Continue

The suggested commands are appropriate:
```bash
# Run in sequence
python3 experiment_system/tools/aub_autopilot.py --registry experiment_system/config/module_registry.yaml --run --select-best
python3 experiment_system/tools/system_autopilot.py --spec experiment_system/config/system_candidates.yaml --run
python3 experiment_system/tools/aub_next_fix.py --registry experiment_system/config/module_registry.yaml --output baseline/reports/next_fix.md
```

System can proceed autonomously. Flag if:
- Worst MDD breaches -15%
- Tuning min drops below 0.0 on any candidate
- Loop time exceeds 15 min consistently
